name: Attilio Marinoni
features: weathered olive skin, dark hair, dark eyes, heavy lined face, strong jaw, sturdy build, serious workmanlike expression
bio: Alfa Romeo's chief test driver, the man who signed off every racing Alfa of the 1930s before it reached a circuit. Marinoni raced when the works needed him, taking a share of the 1928 Mille Miglia win. He was killed in June 1940 testing a 158 on the Milan–Varese autostrada.
